audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0 and 4 read 'Skill' and disagree with the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The mirrored illaoi__tryndamere audit flipped both to Tryndamere as one atomic group and kept EVEN 6/10 — Illaoi's 51.88% comes from side-lane and teamfight value, not from owning lane stages. Level 1 she has no kill threat without Test of Spirit; level 6 Undying Rage answers Leap of Faith outright.
audit.corrected: Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere — rows 0 and 4 as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and the ultimate exchange was described without either number.
audit.why: Test of Spirit 16/15/14/13/12s, Harsh Lesson 4s, Tentacle Smash 10/9/8/7/6s, Leap of Faith 120/95/70s, Undying Rage 120/100/80s. Baiting Leap of Faith with nobody else nearby costs her two minutes at rank 1 and gains her one tentacle.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into spikes[2], mid, late, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] says that if she pulls your spirit you should 'walk away from the tentacles entirely'. That is the instruction that creates the Vessel.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Spirits echo a percentage of the damage they take to the original target. If killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target will become a Vessel and begin spawning Tentacles.' Running is one of the two conditions that converts you. The correct play is to stay beside the spirit and keep her off it — the page told a paying player to do the losing thing.
audit.corrected: If Test of Spirit lands, do not run: you become a Vessel only if the spirit dies or you get too far from it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Prophet of an Elder God was never mentioned — neither the terrain condition nor the healing.
audit.why: 'Illaoi and the Vessels she creates spawn Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain… will heal Illaoi if they damage a champion.' Two consequences the page never gave: fighting in open lane starves her of tentacles entirely, and every tentacle that connects heals her, which is what makes Grievous Wounds decide the late brawl rather than armour.
audit.corrected: Tentacles spawn only on impassable terrain — fight her in open lane; and every tentacle that connects heals her.

audit.whatIsWrong: Harsh Lesson's auto-attack reset was absent.
audit.why: It is a 4s leap that also resets her attack and pulls every nearby tentacle into swinging at you — the swing is the tell, not a cast bar, and 4s means it is essentially always available.
audit.corrected: Harsh Lesson is a 4s leap and an auto reset — the swing is the tell.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are an even farm phase since Illaoi has no kill threat without landing E.
edits.after: Level 1 she has no kill threat without E, and your raw Fury stats win the trade.

edits.before: At level 5 R Undying Rage lets you survive her R storm and kill her, favoring you.
edits.after: At 6 Undying Rage rides out Leap of Faith and its tentacle ring, so bait it.

edits.before: Never stand near her tentacles or in a spawned Test of Spirit vessel — her E rips your spirit and the tentacle slams shred you fast. Use E Spinning Slash to dodge her Q tentacle smash, not to engage, and only trade when tentacles are on cooldown.
edits.after: Tentacles only spawn on impassable terrain, so fight in open lane and most of her damage has nowhere to stand. Harsh Lesson is a 4s leap and an auto reset — the swing is the tell, and it makes every nearby tentacle swing at you too.

edits.before: With crit you can burst her between tentacle slams, but you must respect Test of Spirit — if she pulls your spirit, walk away from the tentacles entirely rather than fighting her at full tentacle count.
edits.after: If Test of Spirit lands, do not run: you become a Vessel only if the spirit dies or you get too far from it. Stay beside your spirit, keep her off it, and let the 16s cooldown expire before you commit again.

edits.before: Level 5-6 is your spike: R Undying Rage is the perfect answer to her R Leap of Faith, letting you tank the whole tentacle storm and heal through with Q while she blows her biggest cooldown for nothing.
edits.after: Level 6 is your spike: Leap of Faith is 120s at rank 1 and spawns a tentacle per champion hit, so baiting it out alone costs her two minutes. Undying Rage rides the storm; Bloodlust pays for it after.

edits.before: With crit you can duel her when her tentacles are down, but late game she out-scales you — a full tentacle field plus tank items out-damages your R window, so avoid the committed brawl and only engage after she uses E and R.
edits.after: Her tentacles heal her whenever they hit a champion, so Grievous Wounds is the item that decides the late brawl, not armour. Fight her away from walls where they cannot spawn, and commit after Test of Spirit's 16s and Leap of Faith's 120s.

edits.before: Land Test of Spirit E to shred your spirit vessel
edits.after: Land Test of Spirit and kill the spirit for a Vessel

edits.before: Dodging this is the whole matchup. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1 — commit only inside that window.

notes: The packet's suspectName is a false positive — 'Test of Spirit' matches the kit exactly; the checker was tripped by the surrounding words. I did rewrite wants.foe[0] anyway, because 'shred your spirit vessel' conflated the spirit and the Vessel, which are two different states. Left alone per the mirror: the '5 seconds' duration attributed to Undying Rage — Riot's text gives no duration, so no new sentence repeats it; I used the 120s cooldown instead. Also left alone: Illaoi is called 'him'/'his' in breakdown.mid, breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, report[8], report[9] and report[12].
